text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after her half-hearted scrimmage,
Special Week shows up to
training for a
practice run.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... I'm not done yet! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm not going down without a fight!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder
begin to pick up their pace,
Special Week
concedes her space and makes way for the
other two to
pass.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She is unmotivated, and it shows in her
running. During partner
running, her
friends also seem confused seeing such a
downtrodden
Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All right, enough of this! What's going on,
Spe?! Out with it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Where's your usual motivation?! Tenacity!
Grit! What happened to
you?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El... Um, well... I'm s-sorry...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Sigh. You know what? Fine, have it your way! We're done partner running for today.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I can't run with you when you're like this,
Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: E-El...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Spe... I think I'm going to call it for
today too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass... U-um... I'm sorry! I—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Don't be sorry, Spe. Whatever it is, we
know it isn't your fault, so
don't go
blaming yourself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's just... You seem lost, and running
without a sense of direction is
dangerous.
Peace of mind, peace in running, yes? You
could hurt
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No need to rush, though. Okay, Spe? Take
your time calming down.
Facing yourself
comes after that.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It just so happens that the person who can
best help you is already
here.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Um, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Heheh... Now then, I'll take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay... Thanks, Grass.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm sorry. I just can't find the
motivation to run.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass is right... I think I'm lost.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? How do you know that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see... That must have surprised you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I was... also a bit shocked.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've never really been around other
Umamusume, and this is my first
time
making friends, so... it's also the first time
a friend has yelled at
me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was so surprised. It was like a wave of
chills swept over my entire
body.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: And ever since then, I've felt... off.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I try to run faster—try to
win—that wave of chills comes
back, and
my body refuses to listen.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what should I do? Will I ever be
able to run again?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Am I gonna be like this forever?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I just... I don't... What do I even do?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week crouches down and tightly
holds on to her knees, tears
rolling down
her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to sit by her side to keep an eye
on her until she finally calms
down.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hic... Phew... Sorry again, Trainer. I think I feel better now.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The sun's already setting, huh? Y'know...
When I first moved here, I
thought the
days were super long, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Spe! I finally found you... Oh. Um, I'm
sorry! Am I interrupting
something?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're fine, Suzuka! Do you need me
for anything?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Well, a letter from your mom arrived at the
dorm, so I thought I
should bring it to you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you always get so excited
whenever you receive a letter from
your
mom, so...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you, Suzuka! You really shouldn't
have!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka hands her the letter and
swiftly takes her leave. In her
own way,
she's also worried about her roommate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the letter now in her hands, Special
Week slowly opens the
envelope and
reads the letter from top to bottom.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Same ol', same ol'.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, uh... right. my mom's closing line. It's
always the same.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Spe, my dear. I wish you a life of
happiness, forever and always."
She's been
telling me the same thing for as long as I
can remember.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My mom who raised me... and my Mama
gave birth to me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My Mama actually passed away before I
could even open my own
eyes. I've only
ever seen pictures of her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But her best friend took me in and raised
me as her own. She made
me the person I
am today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mom told me that all Mama wished was
that I find peace and
happiness—that the
entirety of Mama's hopes and dreams lie
within
me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Isn't it amazing? I get to have two
mothers! And they both
love me more than
anything!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: They really are... the best...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...What I am doing?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, if you'll excuse me for a moment...
I'd like some time alone to
run around this
area.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without another word, Special Week
sprints off, and I watch her back
disappear
into the distance.
